function named(value: unknown): value is { name: string } {
  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && 'name' in value;
}
function report(value: { age: number } | null) {
  if (named(value)) console.log(value.age, value.name);
  else console.log('unnamed');
}
function checkArray(value: string | undefined) {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) console.log(value.toUpperCase());
  else console.log(value ?? 'missing');
}
function verifyDomains(
  nullable: null & { first: number },
  undefinable: undefined & (() => void),
  intrinsic: object & 'value',
  withAny: any & null & { first: number },
  compatible: string & { marker: true },
) {
  const a: never = nullable;
  const b: never = undefinable;
  const c: never = intrinsic;
  const d: never = withAny;
  return compatible.toUpperCase();
}
report({ age: 42, name: 'Ada' } as { age: number; name: string });
report(null);
checkArray('text');
checkArray(undefined);
